knowledge_graph.title: Systemic inflammatory response syndrome
knowledge_graph.description: In immunology, systemic inflammatory response syndrome is an inflammatory state affecting the whole body. It is the body's response to an infectious or noninfectious insult. Although the definition of SIRS refers to it as an "inflammatory" response, it actually has pro- and anti-inflammatory components.

text_blocks.snippet: CIRS, or Chronic Inflammatory Response Syndrome, is a complex illness triggered by exposure to certain biological toxins, often from mold. It's characterized by the immune system's inability to clear these toxins, leading to chronic inflammation and a wide range of symptoms. These symptoms can be debilitating and affect multiple systems in the body, making diagnosis challenging.
snippet_highlighted_words: a complex illness triggered by exposure to certain biological toxins, often from mold

list.title: Toxin Exposure:
list.snippet: CIRS is typically triggered by exposure to biotoxins, such as mycotoxins from mold in water-damaged buildings, though other sources like Lyme disease and cyanobacteria can also be implicated.

list.title: Immune System Dysfunction:
list.snippet: The core issue in CIRS is the body's inability to effectively eliminate these toxins, often due to genetic predisposition or immune system compromise.

list.title: Chronic Inflammation:
list.snippet: The retained toxins trigger a persistent inflammatory response, leading to a cascade of negative effects throughout the body.

list.title: Diverse Symptoms:
list.snippet: CIRS symptoms are varied and can include fatigue, cognitive impairment (brain fog, memory issues), sleep disturbances, mood swings, muscle and joint pain, and more.

list.title: Not Always Detected by Standard Tests:
list.snippet: Many conventional medical tests may not effectively identify CIRS, making diagnosis difficult and potentially delayed, according to a health blog from Hina Zaman, MD.

list.title: Treatment Focus:
list.snippet: Treatment typically involves addressing the source of the toxins, supporting the body's detoxification processes, and managing the symptoms.

text_blocks.snippet: In essence, CIRS is a condition where the body's response to environmental toxins leads to a chronic inflammatory state, impacting various aspects of health and well-being.
